questions.question_text: Material used for the construction of transformer core is usually
questions.answer: Silicon steel has high permeability and low hysteresis loss, and is laminated to cut eddy losses.

questions.question_text: The function of choke and starter in a fluorescent lamp circuit is to
options: Reduce the power consumed by the fluorescent lamp
Create a high voltage across the tube during starting
Help to draw very high current during starting
Improve the power factor of the fluorescent lamp circuit
questions.answer: The choke produces a high inductive voltage kick when the starter opens the circuit, which strikes the discharge.

questions.question_text: Transistor can be used as an amplifier when it is operated
options: In both saturation and cut-off regions
questions.answer: Linear amplification needs the active region; saturation and cut-off distort the signal.

questions.question_text: Moving coil instruments can be used on
questions.answer: A PMMC (moving coil) meter deflects in proportion to the average current, so it reads DC only.

High gauge factor and high sensitivity
Low gauge factor and low sensitivity
Low gauge factor and high sensitivity
questions.answer: A good strain gauge has a high gauge factor ($\Delta R/R$ per unit strain) and high sensitivity to detect small strains.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is not a pressure measurement transducers?
questions.answer: A thermocouple senses temperature (Seebeck effect); piezoelectric, strain gauge and LVDT-based sensors are used for pressure.

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements is true, according to Demorgan's theorem
Connecting of inverters at all the inputs of an AND gate produces a
questions.answer: Inverting each input of an AND gate gives $\overline{A}\,\overline{B}=\overline{A+B}$, which is NOR.
